headlines.title: Blanche Scraps ‘Anti-Weaponization’ Fund Ahead of Nomination
headlines.description: Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche’s nomination appears to be back on track after he announced a key decision to satisfy two Republican holdouts in the Senate who said they could not support his confirmation until the “anti-weaponization” fund was rescinded in writing. Now, Blanche posted an order establishing, “Beyond any doubt, there is no fund.” NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Senate leaders reach a deal to avert a shutdown before the 2026 elections
headlines.description: Senate leaders have struck a bipartisan agreement to keep the government funded past the 2026 midterm elections and avoid a shutdown in October.

headlines.title: Trump says U.S. has had 'many talks' with Iran
headlines.description: President Donald Trump told reporters the U.S. continues to hold talks with Iran to reach a new peace deal focused on reopening the Strait of Hormuz and Tehran's nuclear program.

headlines.title: Michigan reports two deaths linked to cyclosporiasis outbreak
headlines.description: Michigan's Department of Health and Human Services has reported that two people have died in connection to the outbreak of cyclosporiasis. NBC News medical contributor Dr. Natalie Azar has details on the disease and symptoms to watch for.

headlines.title: ‘Spider-Man’ scores biggest opening weekend in box office history, overtaking ‘Avengers: Endgame’
headlines.description: The two blockbusters together pulled in more than $400 million at the domestic box office this weekend.

headlines.title: Spanish Soccer Star Ferran Torres Talks World Cup Win
headlines.description: Soccer star Ferran Torres joins TODAY to talk about Spain’s 2026 FIFA World Cup championship and shares insight into his epic extra-time goal in the final that sealed his team’s victory over Argentina. He also opens up about his mental health journey and gets surprised with gifts for his two dogs!

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Ariana Grande’s break from the spotlight sparks fresh debate over body commentary
headlines.description: The pop star has repeatedly assured her fans she is in good health. But speculation has only grown online, most recently with the release of her “petal” music video.

headlines.title: What we know about the victims of the Idaho shooting
headlines.description: One was a worker at the popular In-N-Out burger chain in Twin Idaho Falls, Idaho, taking care of customers.

headlines.title: Feds charge ‘frustrated’ FBI agent they say stole nearly $1 million in crypto from Russia
headlines.description: The FBI supervisory special agent believed the FBI “could not or would not act against adversarial cryptocurrency accounts,” prosecutors said.

headlines.title: Michigan’s primary reflects a Democratic base transforming in Trump 2.0: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: Welcome to From the Politics Desk, a daily newsletter that brings you the NBC News Politics team’s latest reporting and analysis from the White House, Capitol Hill and the campaign trail.

headlines.title: Ethics panel recommends censure for GOP congressman for ‘inappropriate conduct’
headlines.description: The House Ethics Committee is recommending that Rep. Chuck Edwards, R-N.C., be censured by after finding that he engaged “inappropriate conduct towards two young female staffers.”
